sentence: Jovulations hollow fast without a barbekennic to hold them.

wombos.definition: Cheerful, enthusiastic congratulations delivered with genuine joy and high energy. Used as a noun: 'screamed jovulations.'
wombos.example: When she crossed the finish line, the crowd erupted in jovulations.

wombos.definition: An outdoor meal combining the casual ease of a picnic with the smoky, savory satisfaction of barbecue chicken.
wombos.example: We set up a blanket in the park and had ourselves a proper barbekennic.
